title: Conclave: Alt+C opens a dialog that asks the ticked agents to coordinate and share resources
story: Alt+C now opens a Conclave dialog from anywhere in Maestro. It sends one message to the Claude Code terminals you tick, asking them to message each other and share ports, files and worktrees; reached terminals show the amber header message icon with sender 'Conclave', and Settings → Shortcuts gains an Alt+C row. The dialog takes keyboard focus, so Esc closes it without reaching the terminal behind. Nothing earlier was removed.

checks.criterion: Alt+C opens the dialog; Esc and Cancel close it without sending
checks.steps: Start Maestro, launch two Claude terminals, click into one terminal, press Alt+C, press Esc. Press Alt+C again and click Cancel.
checks.expected: The dialog 'Do you want to invoke Conclave?' opens with the cursor in its message box each time; Esc and Cancel close it; nothing reaches any terminal and no running turn is interrupted.

checks.criterion: The list shows every running Claude Code terminal by project, parked ones tagged, nothing ticked; Invoke needs two ticks and text
checks.steps: Open two projects with Claude terminals plus one plain shell, park one Claude terminal, press Alt+C, tick one, click All, then empty the text box.
checks.expected: The shell is not listed, the parked one shows 'parked', Invoke stays off with one tick, turns on after All, and turns off again with empty text.

checks.criterion: The text box opens with the default message every time
checks.steps: Alt+C, change the text, Cancel, Alt+C.
checks.expected: The default 'Conclave: you and these agents are asked to coordinate…' text is back and nothing is ticked.

checks.criterion: Invoke sends the text plus the agent list to exactly the ticked terminals
checks.steps: Tick two terminals (e.g. 'fox' in alpha-app and 'owl' in beta-app), click Invoke Conclave.
checks.expected: The dialog closes; both terminals receive the text ending in 'Agents in this Conclave: fox (alpha-app), owl (beta-app)'; each header shows the amber icon with sender 'Conclave'.

checks.criterion: The warning shows only when skip permissions is on and a terminal is ticked
checks.steps: Turn on skip permissions for Claude in Settings, press Alt+C, tick one terminal; then repeat with the setting off.
checks.expected: 'These agents will ask you to approve each message…' appears after the tick only when the setting is on.
A row 'Invoke Conclave (ask the ticked agents to coordinate)' with Alt + C.
